item.title: NSU to Host Reception for Incoming President Dr. Alan LaFave
item.description: ABERDEEN, S.D. (NSU) – Northern State University invites the campus and Aberdeen community to welcome Dr. Alan LaFave at a public reception on Friday, Nov. 21, from 3–5 p.m. in Kessler’s Champion Club in the Barnett Center.

item.title: Robert “Bob” McAllister
item.description: Robert “Bob” McAllister, age 73, of Valley City, ND, died Saturday, November 15 at Sanford Health in Fargo, ND, surrounded by his family. A Funeral Mass will be celebrated on Monday, November 24, 2025, at 2:00 p.m.

item.title: Jeff Engle
item.description: Jeff Engle, 58 of Denver, formally from Rogers, North Dakota died in June. A Memorial for Jeff will be Saturday, November 22nd at 2pm at Bethel Lutheran Church in Rogers, North Dakota with Pastor Terry Monson officiating.

item.title: Hi Liner Teen CERT Program Update
item.description: VALLEY CITY, N.D. (NewsDakota.com) – Valley City High School launched its Teen Community Emergency Response Team (Teen CERT) program earlier this year, it’s a hands-on training initiative that equips students with critical emergency preparedness and response skills.
